details: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has replaced 90% of the $6.3 billion stolen in a record hack on October 29, promising to cover all losses for users. Withdrawals are expected to resume by November 1. Analysts and the FBI attribute the attack to North Korean state-sponsored hacking units, raising concerns about cyber security in the crypto space.
title: Binance Recovers 90% of Stolen Crypto, Assures Users After Major Hack

details: Global financial markets, encompassing both traditional assets and cryptocurrencies, are experiencing a sell-off as November begins. This downturn is primarily driven by renewed geopolitical tensions contributing to higher oil prices, persistent inflation concerns, and ongoing uncertainty surrounding the latest Federal Reserve monetary policy, which has not alleviated market caution.
title: Global Markets Decline on Geopolitical Tensions, Rising Oil Prices, and Fed Policy

details: On October 30, US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded their largest single-day net outflow since June, amounting to $643.2 million. Additionally, Ether ETFs experienced significant withdrawals. These outflows signal reduced institutional investor interest and contribute to a bearish sentiment within the broader cryptocurrency market.
title: US Spot Bitcoin & Ether ETFs See Major Outflows Amid Market Uncertainty
